what_this_release_is: The pre-merge fix pack (PR #61) merged to main and deployed. The engine still runs DEMO. No production credential exists, so the LIVE READ_ONLY transition is prepared but NOT performed.

binds_to.note: The merge commit carries the audited tree byte for byte. git diff 0e44b40..3d1cc2b is empty, so the independent review, the mutation matrix and the CI runs on 0e44b40 all describe exactly the tree that was built and deployed.

merge_gate.rule: merge only if PR #61 head is exactly 0e44b40f04a6f44d9c92479b98918c5d276fad1d

ci.checks: image-contains-artifacts SUCCESS; a-red-suite-blocks-the-build SUCCESS; CodeQL python SUCCESS; CodeQL actions SUCCESS
ci.red_suite_canary: a deliberately failing suite does fail the image build, so a green build is not vacuous

builder.proof: BuildKit emitted the Dockerfile stage step '[tests 7/7] RUN python -c ...test_report.json...', matching 'FROM python AS tests' in the Dockerfile, and ran the project suite as a build step. Railpack never runs a project's test suite and has no stage named tests.
builder.finding: The service-level stored builder reads RAILPACK while railway.json pins DOCKERFILE. Config-as-code wins at build time, so the deployed image is the Dockerfile image. The stored setting is misleading and should be corrected to DOCKERFILE so the two agree.

in_image_suite.note: 949 = 944 discovered by unittest + 5 module-level, compared against real pytest rather than hard-coded. This ran inside the image that is now deployed, not on a developer machine.

delta_review.reviewer_independence: produced by a separate session with no authoring history on the fix pack; the author of 0e44b40 did not review it

credential_check.method: Railway get-service-config variableNames, which lists names without values
credential_check.note: Only DEMO credentials exist. No production key id or private key was created, read, printed or inferred.

live_read_only_transition.why_configuration_was_held: Setting PROD_ACCESS_MODE=READ_ONLY and the live-read-only start command before credentials exist would make the process fail its credential gate and crash-loop, taking the engine off DEMO and collecting no data. The configuration is prepared and applied in one step once the credentials are present.

prepared_configuration.start_command_reason: The Dockerfile CMD ends in --demo. A live read-only boot requires an explicit Railway start command. --demo and --live-read-only are never combined.

open_findings.summary: An async def METHOD inside a unittest.TestCase can still report green. tests/_collect.py refuses module-level async and generator functions and fails an un-awaited result, but does not inspect methods of collected TestCase classes. unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase is legitimately exempt.
open_findings.reproduced: pytest reports 1 passed for a deliberately failing async test method while run_tests.py exits 0 and reports ran:950
open_findings.fix_status: NOT REVIEWED, NOT MERGED, NOT DEPLOYED
open_findings.note: Recorded deliberately rather than concealed. It affects the artifact the LIVE gatekeeper reads, so it must close before capital.

open_findings.summary: Provenance telemetry is computed but never logged. Binance klines returned HTTP 451 in 468 of 468 DEMO cycles and a fallback supplied data every cycle, but accepted providers log at DEBUG only, and data_quality_score, klines source, spot_sources and source_dispersion are never emitted. Which provider actually fed the model is unobservable from logs.
open_findings.consequence: The per-decision provenance fields the audit requires will be MISSING on the LIVE shadow stream until telemetry is added.

open_findings.summary: Railway's stored service builder reads RAILPACK while railway.json pins DOCKERFILE. The Dockerfile is what actually builds, but the two settings disagree and a future change to railway.json handling would silently switch builders.
The Dockerfile runtime stage ships run_tests.py, tests/ and _bootstrap.py into the deployed image. No execution path reaches them.
tools/restart_harness.py runs in no CI step and in neither Docker stage.
model_validation.json is stale, generated 2026-09-01 at acb9c01. approved:false remains correct.

closed_by_this_release: F1 (unittest discovery under-counted the suite the LIVE gatekeeper reads): the collector is canonical and the counts are compared against real pytest rather than hard-coded
F2 (source-order string index in a gate test): replaced with a behavioural check plus an AST check

E2 (no environment-keyed read-only enforcement): PROD_ACCESS_MODE with read-only dominance, a transport backstop that fails closed on any verb it cannot prove is a read, and a startup refusal when write authorization is already armed
